affinity.notes: Carapace, engraved membranes, and nest-like structures read as organic ornament rather than elemental matter.

anatomy.notes: Crowned torso, multiple arms, and segmented abdomen read as an intentional insect hybrid.

archetype.notes: Sovereign and summoner communicates the wax-comb production duty.

counterplay.notes: Raised appendages and exposed central segmented body cue frontal barrages or summoning with a clear central target.

finish.notes: Dense ornament remains controlled by a clear central focal line.

framing.notes: Throne-like lateral structures and huge body are strongly staged.

identity.notes: Armored insect brood empress identifies the Hive Queen form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T5; exact intended tier is T5.
